scope: Read all 11 passages, three periods and ending; checked ten original or institutional sources against exact claims and applied runtime source budget. The author and checker are the same person.

sourcesChecked.checked: Direct museum essay supports Mauryan chronology, Chandragupta/Bindusara reach, Ashoka and Megasthenes' attributed Pataliputra description.
Direct Archaeological Survey of India listing reports excavated Pataliputra wooden palisade; card does not treat ancient tower count as archaeological measurement.

Direct Met object page gives broad date, Maurya attribution and tentative jeweller's-mould interpretation.

Direct Met publication locates roads, towns, coins, guilds and finance in the broader sixth-to-third-century South Asian period; card avoids assigning all to Mauryan decree.

limits: This is an author self-check, not independent historical certification.
Edicts are royal statements of intent; the card does not infer universal implementation or medical efficacy.
